description: This C# source file defines the DbTestAppFactory class used for setting up a test environment with a database backend, either via managed connection strings or Docker-based PostgreSQL containers, for integration testing of the DataAssetBackend system. It includes methods for provisioning databases, applying migrations, and creating authenticated clients for tests, with detailed handling of environmental conditions and dependencies.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A specialized WebApplicationFactory for integration testing with a database backend, supporting auto-provisioning of PostgreSQL either via environment variables or Docker containers, and managing setup tasks like migrations and authentication for tests.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Creates an HTTP client configured with authorization headers and a fixed correlation ID for testing authorized endpoints.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the web host configuration to set environment, inject connection string, and replace certain services to ensure proper database connectivity during tests.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs setup before tests run, including provisioning the database, applying migrations, and obtaining an access token.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes resources such as the PostgreSQL container after tests complete.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsAsync
methods.description: Executes SQL migration scripts in order to set up the database schema.
